## Dashboard

A grid of metric tiles: each tile has a `label`, a `value`, an optional `detail` line and an `intent` (`neutral` or a State Pill hue). The grid auto-fits to a minimum tile width. A tile given `onOpen` renders as a real button with an open cue and hover and focus states, because every tile that reports a set should be a door into that set.

```gts
import { Dashboard, type DashboardTile } from '@cardstack/catalog/components/dashboard';

<Dashboard @tiles={{this.tiles}} @tileMin='10rem' />
```

Intent hues are semantic state and stay separate from the theme's accent, so a breach reads red whatever the brand colour is. The component knows no domain: the host decides what each tile counts and what opening it does.

### Example
`DashboardExample/support-today` shows one tile per intent: neutral, healthy, warning and breach. The warning and breach tiles have `onOpen`, so they render as buttons into the tickets they count.

### Non-goals
Not a chart library: no series, axes or sparklines. Not a page layout; it is one grid to place inside the host's own layout.
